basis: Team presentation, slide 6. Fixed forecast before any verified lunar outcomes in the evidence archive.

model.event: Sustained sample flame spread after the igniter stops.
model.oxygen_limit_distribution: Single Normal threshold shared by the four burns. Sustained spread if starting oxygen exceeds threshold.
model.length_assumption: At the mean threshold use 20 * clamp((starting O2 - 26) / 8, 0, 1) cm. Linear oxygen use with burned length and the maximum eight-point depletion are assumptions. Zero means zero sustained travel in this calculation.

predictions.nasa_expectation: Expected to burn down to the oxygen limit.
Expected to burn down to the oxygen limit.
Expected to burn down to the oxygen limit.

resolution.yes: The official burn record reports self-sustained flame spread beyond the igniter-influenced region.
resolution.no: A nominal ignition attempt produced no ignition, or the official record reports no such spread after power ended.
resolution.pending: No attributable official result available. Retain the source, test identifier, actual conditions, and outcome rationale for each resolution.
resolution.void: Insufficient telemetry, changed material or geometry, invalid initial conditions, hardware fault, abort, or ambiguous classification.
resolution.missing_policy: Score only resolved tests on matched indices. Report coverage. A full four-burn score requires four resolved tests.

primary_score: Mean of (p_sustain - observed_binary_outcome)^2, lower is better. Compare on matched burns with the 0.90/0.90/0.90/0.10 project comparator. NASA provided qualitative expectations only.
secondary_length_evaluation: For valid burns with attributable measured sustained travel, report signed and absolute error in cm and number available. Reference lengths are point scenarios at the mean limit.
